messages:
alex_support: quick escalation — LumaHealth tenant (luma-982) failing seat provisioning after credentials rotate. Renewal in 21 days, customer worried about launch. case #7789.

nina_csm: Ugh. Any error logs or tenant infra details?

alex_support: Error: 
```
403 PROVISION_DENIED tenant=luma-982 reason=invalid_key_version
module=auth
```
We've retried provisioning twice; some users succeed, others hit 403.

tom_se: They are on Dedicated (us-central). Root cause looks like stale KMS cache on a subset of replica nodes. I can push a cache flush and a hot-reload of keys — needs a 7 minute maintenance window.

olivia_sales: Please include renewal note: they're evaluating premium support add-on. This is high impact.

nina_csm: Draft comms to customer: short apology, what happened (token rotation + partial cache mismatch), what we did (rolled back for affected nodes), immediate next step (7m maintenance to force refresh), and an offer: one week of priority onboarding + account manager check-in. I'll loop olivia.

ops-bot: cache-flush job queued at 2025-06-10T15:12:00Z.

tom_se: Cache flush ran at 2025-06-10T15:19:05Z. Errors dropped from ~10% to ~1.2%. Still validating.

nina_csm: Action items:
- nina_csm: send customer note + cc olivia_sales (in 20m)
- tom_se: run full tenant validation and attach logs (EOD)
- alex_support: update case with handoff summary
- olivia_sales: prep renewal watch note and recommended credit

alex_support: handoff marked. I'll watch case for any reopens.

nina_csm: :white_check_mark: Sent comms and scheduled follow-up call with customer tomorrow 10:00 local.
